name: Truck-position racking interlock
summary: Restricts breaker racking according to its documented operating and truck-position conditions.
description: Restricts breaker racking according to its documented operating and truck-position conditions. An interlocking function permits or blocks an operation according to the positions and conditions of related equipment. Electrical, mechanical and trapped-key interlocks implement different parts of a coordinated operating philosophy.

In a switchgear feeder panel, a control diagram can prevent an incompatible combination of breaker, disconnector and earthing-switch positions. The physical equipment documents determine which restrictions are mechanically enforced. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Breaker and truck states” at the input and “Racking permission” at the output. Mechanical restrictions remain equipment-specific.
